title: Making Tailscale Faster
summary: Tailscale published a technical blog post detailing their efforts to optimize the performance of their WireGuard-based VPN product, focusing on reducing latency and improving throughput through various low-level optimizations in their Go codebase and kernel interaction layers.
problem_solved: Reduces network latency and improves data throughput for Tailscale VPN users by optimizing the data path between network packets and the userspace application.
why_valuable: Provides real-world insights into high-performance networking optimization techniques while demonstrating how open-source projects can systematically improve user experience through engineering excellence.
